summary: GDPR data-subject operations are implemented. The production README documents /api/v1/health/* endpoints. The API has middleware auth that fails closed. The frontend has login/signup with session management. The codebase includes compliance/ directory, privacy policy page, cookie policy, terms, and review policy. The production readiness documentation (PRODUCTION_READY.md, PRODUCTION_READINESS_REVIEW_2026-07-13.md) covers GDPR compliance. The legal risk register (legal_risk_register.md) tracks compliance exposure. Live site has /privacy, /cookies, /terms, /acceptable-use, /review-policy routes.
assertions: API auth middleware fails closed — unauthorised access blocked
Production readiness review dated 2026-07-13 covers GDPR compliance
Legal risk register tracks data protection exposure
Session management via frontend proxy.ts with explicit redirect-to-login on auth failure
